title: SB0659 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54 and Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-26; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514154618 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB0659.pdf (LegiScan doc 2665679))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2023-01-26 (House twin HB 37). The text read repeals TCA 4-54-105 in its entirety (the summary says it removes exclusions from the Act); section 3 sets Class A misdemeanor, Class B misdemeanor and Class E felony penalties. No amendments in the text read.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 4-54-105): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 4-54-105, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 2 (new section, TCA Title 4, Ch. 54): An employee or elected or appointed official of a state or local government entity shall not enforce, or assist in the enforcement, of a federal law in violation of this chapter.
SECTION 3 (new section, TCA Title 39, Ch. 17, Pt. 13): (a) It is an offense for a person to disenfranchise another of the person's constitutional rights in violation of Title 4, Chapter 54. (b) It is an offense for a person to knowingly assist another in violation of subsection (a). (c) It is an offense for a person to order another to violate subsection (a) or (b).
